meta.title: Indonesian Music Today
meta.description: Considering the bevy of concerts and festivals in Indonesia, it’s no surprise that the current musical landscape encompasses a wide range of styles. From soaring ballads to pumped-up rock instrumentals, toe-tapping hooks and more, these are the top new tracks from the Indonesian pop scene and beyond. This playlist is updated regularly—if you like a song, add it to your library.
